# ReserveFlow v1 spec — principal review (input for v2)

Sources reviewed: `inputs/spec.txt` (v1, line refs below are to this dump), `work/v1-sections/*.html`, `inputs/requirements.txt` (official PDF: FR-001..012, 6 NFR, US-001..008, sample RTM), `inputs/company.txt` (deck), slide facts in `work/BRIEF.md`.
Lens: correctness vs. official requirements first; then "ponytail" (80 users, 3 rooms, 1–3 devs, 6–8 weeks) — cut anything speculative, never cut trust boundaries.

Overall verdict: v1 is a strong *problem-framing* document (good FR table, correct concurrency design, honest open-questions list) but it is not yet a *build* document. It has no RTM, no admin user/room/settings management, no calendar mockup for the Must-have FR-001, no notification/permission matrices, two competing tech stacks, and ~20 questions it could have answered itself. v2 should keep v1's bones and convert every "open" into a decision.

## 3. Decisions v2 should just MAKE (v1 Q-01..Q-20)

"Open?" = must truly remain open for the business (v2 still states the default and builds to it).

| Q | Recommended default | One-line rationale | Open? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-01 Conflict policy | Auto room = first commit wins (DB constraint); Manual room = overlapping PENDING allowed, admin approves exactly one, others auto-rejected in the same txn. | It is literally the business slide ("Admin decides which agenda is more important") reconciled with NFR-1. | No |
| Q-02 24h site vs 08:30–17:30 | Site 24/7; selectable times within business hours from settings; **no admin out-of-hours override in MVP** (admin can change hours in settings). | Override = extra permission + UI for a case nobody asked for. | No |
| Q-03 FR-009 missing from slide | PDF is source of truth; FR-009 Must, in MVP. | Slide omission, not a decision. | No |
| Q-04 RTM wrong | Build correct RTM (§2.1). | Graded/expected deliverable. | No |
| Q-05 ReserveFlow vs VenueFlow | Working name ReserveFlow; name is a single config constant + logo asset. | Zero build impact; branding belongs to the business. | **Yes** (branding only) |
| Q-06 Pending holds slot? | Auto rooms: no pending. Manual rooms: pending does not block other pending; shows "มีคำขอรออนุมัติ" badge; any CONFIRMED blocks. | Follows Q-01. | No |
| Q-07 Room-only vs resources | Room-only; `rooms` table; no abstraction for later. | YAGNI; 3 rooms. | No |
| Q-08 Identity | Admin-provisioned local accounts (CSV import + create); no self-registration; SSO later if company has Workspace/M365. | Admin already needs user management; SSO adds an IdP dependency for 80 users. | Confirm only (low cost to add OAuth later) |
| Q-09 Login fields | `employee_code` + password; mobile on profile. | Mobile as a login factor adds friction, no security. Reversible in an hour if the business insists. | Confirm (business showed 3 fields) |
| Q-10 Booking days | Mon–Fri + admin-managed holiday list (seed Thai public holidays). | Admin-configurable → never blocks. | No (admin setting) |
| Q-11 Increment / min / max / buffer | 30-min steps; min 60; max = bounded only by business hours (no artificial 4h cap); buffer 0. | Business asked only for min 1h; a cap is an invented rule; admin can cancel abuse. | Confirm max (low stakes) |
| Q-12 "1 month" | 30 days rolling, shown in UI ("จองล่วงหน้าได้ถึง …"). | Predictable, no month-length edge cases. | No |
| Q-13 Reschedule re-approval | Time/room change re-runs policy (auto: atomic update; manual: back to PENDING, old slot released, user warned); other field edits never re-approve; admin reschedule stays CONFIRMED. | Prevents bypassing approval; matches FR-008 "slot returns immediately". | No |
| Q-14 Cancel deadline / admin cancel | Owner: edit/cancel until `start_at`; Admin: cancel any time before `end_at`, reason required, notify + audit. | Simple, no partial-cancel states; no-show handled by auto-release. | No |
| Q-15 Private visibility | Full details: owner, attendees (email matches a user), admins. Everyone else: "Busy" + room/time. Facility (1.1): room/time/headcount/special_request only. | Minimal need-to-know; testable (TC-PRV-004). | No |
| Q-16 Check-in window | T-15 min → T+15 min; auto-release at T+15 if not checked in. | Aligns reminder, window and grace into one job. | No |
| Q-17 QR static vs rotating | Static QR per room (printed), login required, owner/attendee only, inside window. | Rotating tokens solve a threat (photographed QR) that login + window already neutralise for an 80-person office. | No |
| Q-18 Facility staff | No role in MVP; Phase 1.1 `FACILITY` read-only "Today" page in admin app; no kiosk. | Secondary stakeholder; one enum value when needed. | No |
| Q-19 Email >99% definition | Measured at provider ("delivered / accepted"); app tracks SENT/FAILED + retries; no webhooks. | Provider dashboards already compute this. | No |
| Q-20 Recurring / waitlist / other TZ / Teams | Out of MVP and 1.1; backlog. | Scope control; no use case stated. | No |
| NEW Q-21 Webboard | Interpret as Admin Dashboard; if the business means announcements → Phase 1.1 banner. | Deck context suggests dashboard. | **Yes** |
| NEW Q-22 Check-in in MVP? | Admin check-in + auto-release in MVP; QR in 1.1. | Deck headlines it as the Ghost-Booking fix. | Confirm (cheap either way) |
| NEW Q-23 Hosting / email domain | Default docker-compose on a VM or managed PG + container; sender `noreply@<company domain>` with SPF/DKIM. | Needs company IT. | **Yes** |
| NEW Q-24 Which rooms are Manual; who are admins; 8 department names | Seed: Horizon Manual, Summit/Grove Auto; 1 admin account; placeholder dept names. | Seed data only. | **Yes** (data, not design) |

Truly open for the business: Q-05 (name), Q-21 (Webboard), Q-23 (hosting/email domain), Q-24 (seed facts), and low-stakes confirmations Q-08/Q-09/Q-11-max/Q-22. Everything else: decide in v2.

## 4. Missing sections v2 must add

1. **Decided tech stack** — one column, with a 1-line reason per choice and "what changes at 10× scale" footnote (replaces v1 Lean/Scale table).
2. **Monorepo folder structure** — tree with one sentence per folder; note whether employee+admin are one app (R-41).
3. **Ticket-level plan** — per week: tickets (ID, title, FR/US refs, size S/M/L, depends-on), milestone demo per week, DoD.
4. **Permission matrix** — role × action (R-17), including owner/attendee rules for private bookings.
5. **Notification matrix** — event × recipient × channel × template × .ics method: created-auto (owner + attendees .ics), pending-created (owner ack, admins), approved (owner + attendees .ics), rejected (owner), cancelled-by-owner (attendees .ics CANCEL), cancelled-by-admin (owner + attendees), rescheduled (owner + attendees .ics update), auto-released (owner [+admin]), pending-expired (owner), reminder T-15 (owner), account-created/password-reset (user). Thai subject lines.
6. **State machine table** — from → to, actor, preconditions, side-effects (email, audit, slot), which job produces it (R-19).
7. **Booking policy & validation catalogue + error catalogue** — settings-driven rules, HTTP code, error code, Thai message (R-39).
8. **Admin user management spec** (R-01) and **admin rooms/settings/holidays spec** (R-05).
9. **Check-in spec** — both modes, window, job (R-03, R-15).
10. **Calendar view spec + mockup**, admin D&D behaviour (R-04, R-14).
11. **Full DB DDL** — tables, constraints (EXCLUDE, CHECK end>start, CHECK duration ≥ 60 min, FKs, unique keys), indexes; plus background-jobs list (auto-release, reminder, pending-expiry, email outbox) with schedule + idempotency note.
12. **API contract** — every endpoint with request/response example, auth/role, error codes; one example for 409 conflict.
13. **RTM** (§2.1) with Status column.
14. **Env/config** — `DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, APP_URL, EMAIL_PROVIDER/API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, TZ=Asia/Bangkok, NODE_ENV` + settings row vs env split.
15. **Seed data** — 3 rooms (R-25), 8 departments, settings row, Thai holidays 2569, 1 admin, demo employees (dev only), feature list.
16. **Date/time & language conventions** — Asia/Bangkok, พ.ศ. display via th-TH, ISO in API/.ics/CSV, 24h clock, Thai-only UI with English tech terms (R-35, R-33).
17. **Security checklist** — password policy, lockout, session, CSRF, authz tests, audit list (R-08, R-38).
18. **Deployment & runbook** — docker-compose, migrations, backups/restore drill, email domain setup (R-42).
19. **Test plan additions** (R-40) mapped in RTM.
20. **Glossary TH/EN** — การจอง/Booking, คำขอจอง/Request, รออนุมัติ/Pending, ยืนยันแล้ว/Confirmed, เช็คอินแล้ว/Checked-in, ปล่อยห้องอัตโนมัติ/Auto-released, หมดอายุ/Expired, ว่าง/Available, ไม่ว่าง/Busy, ประชุมลับ/Private, เวลาทำการ/Business hours, วันหยุด/Holiday, อัตราการใช้งาน/Utilization, ผู้จอง/Owner, ผู้เข้าร่วม/Attendee, ผู้ดูแลระบบ/Admin, ทีมจัดห้อง/Facility.
21. **Risks & assumptions** — hosting unknown, email deliverability, business may insist on 3-field login/self-registration, FullCalendar licence if chosen.
22. **Out-of-scope list** (explicit) — recurring, waitlist, multi-TZ, Teams/Google sync, rotating QR, kiosk, SMS, PDF export, i18n toggle, resources other than rooms, RSVP tracking, per-room hours.

Method: every R-row re-read against the v1 text and the sources; verdicts are in the new "Verdict (verifier)" column above. 0 findings were flatly refuted; 11 were adjusted (mostly: v1 already states the principle, the gap is narrower than written, or the severity was too high); 32 confirmed as written. R-03 proposes **admin-only** check-in in MVP. | Admin-only check-in makes the 15-min auto-release depend on one admin physically reaching 3 rooms on floors 2/4/5 — legitimate meetings get released when the admin is busy. ## 6. Verified summary

**Counts.** 43 reviewer findings: **32 CONFIRMED**, **11 ADJUSTED** (R-02 severity; R-04, R-06, R-12, R-13 narrower than written — v1 states the principle; R-07 partly refuted — v1's FR-002 row already has the filters, only the plan label is wrong; R-11 interpretation speculative; R-18, R-20, R-25 over-stated — v1 already proposes/declares what the fix asks for; R-35 convention not error + .ics offset correction), **0 REFUTED outright**. **10 verifier additions** (V-01..V-10): 1 High, 4 Medium, 5 Low. Severity re-grades: R-02 → High, R-07 → Medium, R-11 → Medium, R-18 → Low, R-20 → Low, R-25 → Low.

**Top 10 confirmed items, by severity (what v2 must fix first):**

1. **R-01 (Critical)** — Admin user management is absent (no screen/API; "ตั้งค่าระบบ" nav is dead; "ลืมรหัสผ่าน" dead) while v1 itself rules out self-registration → accounts cannot exist. Build it in W1 with the single set-password token flow (V-02).
2. **R-05 (High, stronger than written)** — Rooms / settings / holidays admin is unspecified, and FR-005 (**Must**) has no API/screen to set `approval_mode` at all; no holidays table though FR-012 and Q-10 need it.
3. **R-03 + V-01 (High)** — Check-in exists only as QR; deck says admin-at-room, PDF US-006 says the employee presses it. Ship one `check-in` action with self/admin entry points in MVP, QR as a 1.1 deep link; auto-release + reminder jobs specified (R-15, V-05).
4. **R-10 (High)** — Two competing stacks and a speculative scale-ready architecture (Redis, object storage, worker, ABAC — R-24). v2 states one stack, one deploy target.
5. **R-02 (High)** — No RTM although the PDF shows one as an expected deliverable; build it with the PDF's column set (V-08) and a single phase vocabulary (V-07).
6. **R-04 (High)** — FR-001 Calendar (Must, and the p95 ≤ 2 s NFR target) has only a one-line behaviour: no layout for 3 rooms, no mockup, no admin D&D view (R-14, incl. FullCalendar Premium caveat).
7. **R-06 (High)** — FR-009 (Must) events are scattered across four sections with no recipient matrix, no reminder time, no .ics METHOD/SEQUENCE (R-37, V-06).
8. **R-08 (High)** — Identity undecided: 3-field Stitch login vs Q-09; no password policy, lockout numbers, session length; Register screen is dead surface in prod (R-20).
9. **R-09 (High)** — Plan is six one-liners; needs ticket-level weeks with DoD, re-sequenced so W1 is foundation (users/rooms/settings), and de-overloaded W4 (V-07).
10. **R-12 + R-13 + V-04 (Medium, build-blocking detail)** — Pending-holds-slot and reschedule rules are stated as principles only: loser auto-rejection is not in the transaction, EXPIRED has no producer, old-slot fate on manual re-approval undefined, and any transition to CONFIRMED (not just approve) must reject overlapping pendings.

Next tier (all confirmed): R-26 time picker forbids 1.5 h/2 h bookings and loses 16:30–17:30; R-19 lifecycle has dead states (DRAFT/COMPLETED/EXPIRED); R-17 no permission matrix; R-22/R-23/R-24 over-engineering (per-room hours + TZ, delivery webhooks/dashboard, Redis/worker/ABAC); R-16 utilization formula undefined and mock numbers wrong; R-31 keep idempotency (double-click → two PENDING rows); R-41 one front-end vs two apps is an orchestrator call.
